thread:
Maya Torres: Quick ops thread for Wednesday's webinar (11am PT). Need owners for reg confirmation copy, Typeform->HubSpot mapping, Zoom recording + captions, post-event clips, and partner asset delivery.
Evan Cho: I can co-host and handle Zoom recording + immediate upload to s3. Will leave raw VTT and transcript JSON.
Rina Patel: I'll draft the confirmation + 24h/72h nurture emails. Will include calendar add, on-demand permission, caption ETA (48h), and link tagging params.
Maya Torres: S3 prefix: redwood-marketing/events/2026-integrations/${EVENT_SLUG}/. Evan, include speakers.json metadata with start offsets.
Evan Cho: Upload snippet from my runbook:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/recording.mp4 s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-integrations/${EVENT_SLUG}/recording.mp4 --acl private
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/transcript.json s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-integrations/${EVENT_SLUG}/transcript.json
```
Rina Patel: Typeform -> HubSpot fields: email -> email, name -> firstname+lastname, company -> company, role -> job_title, consent -> marketing_opt_in. Add hidden utm_campaign=integrations_q2_2026 and tag lead property "interest=integrations".
Evan Cho: Enabling "optimize for third-party editor" and auto-transcript now. I'll post S3 path + CloudFront link here within 30m after session.
ops-bot: Preflight reminder scheduled: 2026-04-20T18:45:00Z  mic check, co-host set, cloud recording ON, captions ON. Will ping #marketing 15m prior.
Maya Torres: Clips plan: 2x 2-min highlights + 1x 30s social cut. Rina will coordinate speaker approvals for public clips.
Rina Patel: Draft confirmation posted in thread in 10. Also wiring HubSpot lists: registrants, attendees, non_viewers for 24h/72h cadence.
Evan Cho: After upload I'll include raw_vtt, transcript.json, and cloud_recording_id.txt in S3 so ops can match. Tagging @Rina and @Maya when done.
Maya Torres: If cloud recording missing 30m post-end ops-bot will notify #eng-oncall. Thanks team, ping here with links and any blockers.
